fusions.name: Springe
fusions.desc: Trips a noose on a bent sapling under the target that deals 12 damage and flings it back 3.5 tiles. You move 20% faster for 3 seconds after you use it.

fusions.name: Limed Branches
fusions.desc: Sweeps limed branches through a cone 4 tiles long. The sweep deals 8 damage to every enemy in it and leaves each [Leaden] for 4 seconds. It holds 3 charges, and each kill gives one back.

fusions.name: Hawk on a Creance
fusions.desc: Looses a tethered hawk for 10 seconds that strikes enemies within 4 tiles for 3 damage every second. Each strike has a 30% chance to leave the target [Pinned] for 1.5 seconds.

fusions.name: Grounded Prey Misses
fusions.desc: Against enemies carrying your afflictions, your dodge chance rises by 10%.
